title_en: FOR SALE – MODERN DUPLEX | DRY LAKE
description_en: Duplex apartment for sale in the Dry Lake area, with ample spaces and very functional organization. The property has a net area of ​​180 m², a 20 m² veranda and a south-east orientation, offering natural lighting throughout the day. Equipped with air conditioning in every room and located in a building with only 2 apartments per floor. Area: Net: 180 m² Veranda: 20 m² Shared area: 13 m² Organization: First floor: Living room Separate kitchen 1 bedroom 1 bathroom 1 storage room Second floor: 3 bedrooms 2 bathrooms Master bedroom with wardrobe and office space Balcony in one of the bedrooms Possibility of closed garage with capacity for 2 vehicles, at a price extra. For more information or for a visit to the property, please get in touch.
